description:
In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr and pastor Daniel Miranda address two profound questions concerning the sanctuary doctrine and Christ’s heavenly ministry.

📘 Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real Bible questions answered directly from Scripture.

02:30 – If the veil was torn at the cross, why did Christ minister in two phases in heaven?
Matthew 27:50–51 records that the veil of the earthly temple was torn when Christ died. This signified the end of the earthly sacrificial system and the fulfillment of the types in the true Lamb of God.

But if the veil was torn, why did the heavenly sanctuary still retain a distinction between the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place until 1844? How do we reconcile the rending of the earthly veil with the continued two-phase priestly ministry of Christ and the beginning of the antitypical Day of Atonement?

14:00 – Who was High Priest in heaven before Christ’s ascension?
If Jesus began His High Priestly ministry after His resurrection and ascension, who served in that role prior to His inauguration? Was there a heavenly priesthood before Calvary, and how does this fit into the plan of redemption?

This episode explores:

The torn veil in Matthew 27
The earthly vs. heavenly sanctuary
Christ’s two-phase ministry
The antitypical Day of Atonement
The High Priesthood of Jesus
The sanctuary doctrine in Scripture

💬 Have a Bible question? Leave it in the comments — it may be featured in a future episode.
